overall: The AG found the Committee violated the OML by failing to provide meeting minutes within 10 days of a request; it reminded the Committee to add missing minutes content and ordered future compliance.

allegations.summary: Complainant requested minutes of Committee meetings from August 2010 to April 2011 and did not receive draft minutes until July 2011, more than 10 days later.
allegations.key_passage: The Committee did not provide him with the draft minutes until July 5, 2011, well past the 10 day deadline for complying with such a request.

allegations.summary: Committee took about 29 business days to respond to the open meeting complaint and to notify the AG; the AG noted a procedural filing error by the complainant may have contributed.
allegations.key_passage: In addition, we note that the Committee failed to respond to the complaint until July 5, 2011-29 business days after it was filed.

allegations.summary: Draft minutes omitted the meeting place, members absent, and list of documents used, as required by the minutes statute.
allegations.key_passage: We recognize that the minutes submitted to the complainant were draft minutes, however, and remind the Committee that, if it has not already done so, the Committee should supplement the minutes with the missing information before they are approved as final minutes.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law (G.L. c. 30A, §§ 18-25).
remedy_passage: We order the Committee's immediate and future compliance with the law, and caution that future similar violations may be considered evidence of an intentional violation.
